reason: REAL, UNFIXED. `WORD_CHAR_RE = /[\p{L}\p{N}]/u` drives CommonMark `_`-flanking; a combining mark is neither letter nor digit, so on NFD text the base letter of an accented cluster reads as a word edge and emphasis flanks in the wrong place. Adding `\p{M}` changes markdown parse/serialize behaviour and needs round-trip + conformance coverage, so it is tracked as follow-up rather than slipped into a CI-guard PR.

It must stay byte-identical to its Rust twins (HUMAN_TAG_RE in src-tauri/src/commands/pages/markdown.rs and the same literal in src-tauri/src/commands/pages/inline_query_md.rs), so the fix is a coordinated FE/BE change plus conformance vectors — tracked as follow-up.

REAL, UNFIXED, low severity. `WORD_RE = /[\p{L}\p{N}_]/u` backs the whole-word in-page find; on NFD text a trailing combining mark is read as a word boundary, so whole-word `cafe` matches inside `café`.
